Build the wide data table for one chart from its spec rows

build_chart_data.Rd

Blank aliases are filled via fill_default_aliases first. Then, in position order, each row is fetched (via fetch_fn) or evaluated (its formula, against the table so far), and that row's rolling/growth/index are applied immediately using the same functions prep_chart uses. So a formula sees earlier rows' final values, the same series raw and smoothed are two different columns, and the table is what gets plotted — pass NULL for rolling/growth/index to prep_chart afterwards.

Usage

build_chart_data(
  series_rows,
  con,
  fetch_fn,
  date_valid = NULL,
  schema = "platform"
)

Arguments

series_rows

chart_series rows for exactly one chart_id

con

Database connection object, passed to fetch_fn

fetch_fn

function(codes, con, date_valid, schema) returning a dataframe with period_id plus one column per names(codes). In production pass UMARaccessR::get_series_table; kept as an argument so UMARvisualisR stays DB-agnostic and tests can pass a stub.

date_valid

passed to fetch_fn

schema

passed to fetch_fn

Value

A dataframe with period_id and one column per alias, in position order.

Details

Returns every alias, plotted or not, columns in position order. Subset to plot == TRUE rows before prep_chart; keep the full table for the data export so computed series are auditable against their inputs.
